user_photo.interpretation: The photographed OROBANCHACEAE block contains Boulardia, Orobanche and Phelipanche but no Odontites. This is negative evidence for this printed 2026 catalogue block only and is not evidence of absence from La Rioja.

guards: Absence from the photographed 2026 OROBANCHACEAE block is not absence from La Rioja.
The 2016 regional pattern list is occurrence/list evidence; it does not by itself define current accepted nomenclature.
POWO/WCVP taxonomic acceptance or synonymy is not used to infer Rioja occurrence; occurrence support comes from the regional list.
Historical names remain provenance and must not be silently overwritten.
No threat, protection or ex-situ result is inherited across an identity replacement without fresh downstream execution.
No active-universe mutation is performed with a stale result-universe hash.
